role: The client's reply to a server transaction (S32): window id, transaction uid, accepted flag. The server rolls the container back when the client rejects.
scope_reason: In scope: when the server refuses a click (the stack the client claimed is not the server's result) it answers S32 accepted=false and the client replies with C0F, which puts the player back in the container's player list (processConfirmTransaction's setPlayerIsPresent(true)); misc-refuse-s1 and trade-full-s1 do this.

members.name: field_149536_a (window id)
members.note: the S32's window: 0 or the client's open window (handleConfirmTransaction sends no C0F otherwise)

members.name: field_149534_b (uid)
members.note: the S32's transaction id echoed for the IntHashMap lookup; the lockstep pairs them by tick

members.name: field_149535_c (accepted)
members.note: always true from handleConfirmTransaction; processConfirmTransaction does not read it

members.name: C0FPacketConfirmTransaction
members.note: built by the client's next tick while handling the refused S32, before that tick's clicks go out

members.name: readPacketData
members.note: wire framing; the native engine has no network

members.name: processPacket
members.note: processConfirmTransaction: setPlayerIsPresent(true) on the open container when the window and uid match; it lands ahead of the next tick's C0Es, so native's refusal (the refused flag) lasts to the end of its own row. With the window closed in the refusal's tick no C0F comes, and the closed container is gone

members.name: func_149532_c
members.note: accessor over the packet's fields; the native packets are plain structs

members.name: func_149533_d
members.note: accessor over the packet's fields; the native packets are plain structs

members.name: C0FPacketConfirmTransaction
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

notes: lane/idxmisc 2026-09-27: the second missing entry was wrong: the client handles the refused S32 in PlayerControllerMP.updateController, which runs before the GUI input of the same client tick (Minecraft.runTick), so the C0F precedes that tick's clicks and the server accepts them; misc-refuse-s1 clicks in the tick right after each refusal (rows 26 and 55) and passes test_snapshots and play_check with 0 mismatches. Do not confuse this with the confirm_c03 slots in survival.h's client_out: those are C06 acknowledgements riding an S08, a different mechanism despite the name. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was not_needed/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit). lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records trade-full-s1, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
